Topic: Canada Tourism Index — Methodology & Baseline
Key_Fact: COMPOSITE METRIC: CTI = Canadian trips to U.S. (current) / Canadian trips to U.S. (2019 avg). CALCULATION: 2019 baseline = ~32M trips/year (NTTO). 2025 actual = 22.9M trips (Statistics Canada). Current CTI = 22.9M / 32M = ~0.72. INTERPRETATION: >0.

Topic: StatCan Headline Moderation is Base-Year Effect (Not Boycott Easing)

Restate TOUR-01 threshold as 2-yr stack vs 2024, not YoY.
